column3: \t\tランス城に世界各国から首脳陣が集まり会議が行われる
column4: Leaders from various countries gathered at Rance Castle for a conference.

column3: \t\tが長年の因縁もあり協力関係は作れず混乱状態
column4: However, due to longstanding grudges, no cooperative relations could be formed, resulting in confusion.

column3: \t\tランスがリーダーになり世界をまとめると宣言
column4: Rance declared he would become the leader and unite the world.
